scenes.headline: How a 27B model fits a 12 GB card
scenes.sub: A hashed trellis at 2.5 bits, and a ternary with a draft head.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Oolong! Two builds fit a twenty-seven billion parameter Qwen, and a long window, on a twelve gigabyte card. Here's how.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Store each weight as a step on a trellis: a 16-bit window slides along the bits, and a hash turns each window into weights.
scenes.mark: a hash turns each window into weights
scenes.say: The first build stores weights as a walk on a trellis. A sixteen-bit window slides along the bits, and a hash turns it into weights.

steps.say: Each state may only step to states that share its bits.
The encoder picks the least-error path. The decoder reads values off it.
Each step shifts eight bits into a sixteen-bit state.
A hash spreads it out, and each byte becomes an integer level.
The rotated input becomes two eight-bit planes, so the dot products are exact.

steps.note: 2 bits per weight, 2.125 with the entry byte
steps.say: Eight bits for four weights: two bits each.

scenes.title: What one token costs to remember

parts.note: only 16 of 64 layers keep a cache
parts.say: Only sixteen of sixty-four layers keep a KV cache.
Four heads, two hundred fifty-six wide.
Keys and values: about eighteen kilobytes a token at four bits.

scenes.title: Mirai S at 128K, q4_0 cache
scenes.note: reported peak 11.3, on an RTX 3090 capped to 12 GB
scenes.say: At a hundred and twenty-eight K, weights take seven point six, the cache two and a quarter. The reported peak is eleven point three.

left.title: Stock kernel
left.say: The ternary kernel gave each thread a whole block, so only forty of a hundred and twenty-eight threads worked.

right.title: PR 218
right.say: Spreading the work lifts decode from twenty-five to forty, and the draft head pays: fifty.

items.text: Head drafts the token after next
items.say: The head guesses the token after next.

items.text: Trunk checks both in one pass
items.say: The trunk checks both in one pass.

items.text: Keep the match, redo the miss
items.say: Matches are kept; the output doesn't change.

scenes.text: Fewer bits buy the window. The kernel decides the speed.
scenes.say: Fewer bits buy the window. The kernel decides the speed. Quality is still unmeasured.

recap: A hash, not a table, holds the codes
A faster kernel let the draft head pay
scenes.say: Hashed codes, a sixteen-layer cache, and a kernel that let the draft head pay.
